subject: CardBench status: reference model up, complexity-bucket gap
body:
Hi both,

Milestone 2 is done, four days late but done. The reference GNN-based estimator trains directly on the provided query graphs, no CardBench code needed, exactly as the repo promises - that path is smooth and the internal docs Emeka wrote are already getting used by two optimizer folks.

One finding worth flagging as a risk: the provided training query graphs are generated from queries of different complexities, and our reference model's error is fine on the simple buckets but degrades badly on the highest-complexity joins - q-error at the 95th percentile is ~40x there versus ~4x overall. If the optimizer team evals only on the aggregate, they'll overestimate model quality. I want to publish per-complexity-bucket numbers as the required reporting format before anyone cites a single headline number.

Wanjiru starts the re-generation pipeline this week, on schedule.

Kaia
